_about: Single source for matching meetings (and other sources) to project journals in 30_Projects/Journal/.
Keys of 'projects' must equal a journal filename without .md. Used by 90_System/Skills/meeting_metadata (gcal_today, fireflies_sync, backfill).
domains: external attendee email domains owned by the client (strongest signal; subdomains match). Never add shared domains such as your own company domain, gmail.com or outlook.com.
title_keywords: whole words/phrases matched in the meeting title, case- and diacritics-insensitive. Prefer client names; avoid generic product words shared by several projects.
slack_channels: dedicated Slack channel names (without #) for this project only; shared channels are not listed.
Rule: title keywords and domains must agree on exactly one project, otherwise project stays empty (never guess).
